backend/main.mo: Motoko canister handling authorization, user profiles, cutoff records, lead storage, and CSV import with admin/user access checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking requested UI changes to specific frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of various frontend files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind/OKLCH theme variables defining the navy/light‑blue color palette for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point setting up the root container and loading the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component managing simple page routing within a shared layout and error boundary.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLeadE: Admin-only UI for exporting stored leads as CSV with permission checks, copying, and downloading options.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary displaying a fallback UI with detailed error info and reload option.
frontend/src/components/layout/SiteLayou: Provides the main site layout with header navigation, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/lead-capture/Lea: Implements a modal form that validates and submits user lead details like name, mobile, and WhatsApp.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication and state.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/ContactSupportPage.ts: Renders the support page with contact info, guidelines, and common issue tips.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page showing a banner, feature cards, and a CTA button to start the predictor.
frontend/src/pages/HowItWorksPage.tsx: Explains the predictor steps including input, rank calculation, and cutoff matching using cards and icons.
frontend/src/pages/MhtCetPredictorFormPa: Implements the full predictor form with inputs, backend calls, lead capture, CSV upload, and cutoff checks.
frontend/src/pages/PredictorPage.tsx: Wraps the predictor form with an intro and an alert prompting cutoff data upload.
frontend/src/utils/predictorDefaults.ts: Provides default backend parameters, mainly setting Maharashtra candidature for rank calculations.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters.
frontend/src/utils/validation/whatsapp.t: Validates and normalizes 10‑digit Indian WhatsApp numbers with prefix checks.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's state, including existing and pending feature requests for updating the home page banner and switching the site theme to navy/faint blue. Stores metadata like versioning, issues, and project name.
